purpose: Explicit EGIF source-domain to current INE territory identifiers; no textual matching.

source.basis: EGIF public endpoint community dictionary recorded in ES-1.5; target codes are INE 2026 snapshot identifiers.

province_code_policy: EGIF source province code is normalized only by trimming and zero-padding to two digits, then resolved against the current INE province or province-equivalent code. No name matching.
municipality_code_policy: EGIF source municipality code is a province-local code. A current canonical candidate is formed only as current resolved province-equivalent code plus a zero-padded three-digit municipality code and must exist in the INE snapshot with the same parent. Source code 0 means no municipality declared, not a municipality.
